MP Judge Who Sentenced Cow Vigilantes Receives Death Threats

A judge in Madhya Pradesh, who recently handed down life sentences to individuals convicted of cow vigilantism and mob lynching, has reportedly received death threats. The Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association (SCAORA) has condemned these threats. An FIR has been registered regarding the incident.
